proposed_widenings.name: difficult_terrain
proposed_widenings.justification: Grease creates Difficult Terrain in a 10-foot square for 1 minute. Difficult terrain halves movement speed — mechanically distinct from block_travel (which prevents movement entirely). No v4 atom covers terrain-speed modification.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Nonflammable grease covers the ground in a 10-foot square centered on a point within range and turns it into Difficult Terrain for the duration.

proposed_widenings.name: OngoingOperation.save_gate
proposed_widenings.justification: Grease applies a repeated DEX save gate to every creature that enters the area or ends its turn there. OngoingOperation currently only has roll_modifier and damage_on_hit. A save_gate variant is needed with: ability, dc, onFail (apply_condition prone), onSuccess (none), and a trigger set (enters_area | ends_turn_in_area).
proposed_widenings.evidence: When the grease appears, each creature standing in its area must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or have the Prone condition. A creature that enters the area or ends its turn there must also succeed on that save or fall Prone.

proposed_widenings.name: AnchoredEvent.ends_turn_in_area
proposed_widenings.justification: Grease fires the save gate when a creature ends its turn in the area — a distinct trigger from enters_area. The existing AnchoredEvent union has physical_contact and enters_area but not ends_turn_in_area. (This would also be needed as a trigger kind on the proposed OngoingOperation.save_gate.)
proposed_widenings.evidence: A creature that enters the area or ends its turn there must also succeed on that save or fall Prone.

notes: Two distinct save behaviors exist: an on-cast pulse (creatures in the area when grease appears) and an ongoing per-creature trigger (enter or end-turn). The on-cast behavior could be collapsed into the enter-area trigger with a 'creatures currently in area count as entering' interpretation, but the SRD describes them separately. The primary blocker is (a) no difficult_terrain atom in v4, and (b) no save_gate variant in OngoingOperation. The Condition type already includes 'prone', so no Condition widening is needed.
